SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Post rapid PCR screening for Down syndrome

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphases were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype

INTERPRETATION
No trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities detected. This analysis is sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Subtle structural abnormalities below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics cannot be excluded.

This result supersedes any preliminary findings from rapid aneuploidy screening.

CONCLUSION
Normal chromosomal analysis excluding Down syndrome and other major chromosomal disorders.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
